verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the Big Block prize configuration of nine $24,000 awards and weighted-ticket eligibility.
The client sets the Big Block pool target and draw trigger at exactly $216,000 and specifies that secondary royalties fund the pool.
The client replaces the monetary pool trigger with a 180,000-sales trigger and changes each Big Block award to $6,000; removing the obsolete pool_target preserves consistent replay state.
This is a target-specific implementation claim following the parameter change, explicitly reporting the 180,000 trigger, nine winners, and $6,000 awards as completed.
The client changes the executable Big Block configuration to three winners every 35,000 sales while retaining the $6,000 award amount.
The client explicitly removes the entire Big Block prize mechanism while retaining the continuing $900 prize mechanism.
